identification: Pair of figural term pilasters / wall brackets in Baroque-revival style: atlantes (one bearded older man, one long-haired youth) with arms raised supporting gilt Ionic volute capitals under flat rectangular shelf tops, torso emerging from a tapering gilt-edged pilaster with knotted gilt drapery and tassel, on stepped dark plinths. Painted dark green-black with gold paint/gilt. Flat backs, made to stand against a wall or hang as brackets. About 100 cm. Most likely 20th century decorator pieces (Italian-style or SE Asian workshop carved timber, or cast composition/resin); the separate stepped plinths look newer and plainer than the figures. Armitage estimate A$150-200.

viewing_check: Lift one: heavy and cold = resin/plaster/composition, lighter with tool marks and visible grain at chips = carved timber. Look at the back and underside for joinery, nails, saw marks, old labels or a maker/importer sticker; read the paper tag; see whether the plinths and shelf tops are later additions and whether there are wall-hanging fittings. Only worth chasing if clearly carved timber with some age.
